activation_condition: the complete 25-pair frozen_initial plus active_contact_mean pilot fails the unchanged preregistered mean-foot-sliding criterion

motivation_snapshot.interpretation: freezing the released stationary-and-grounded three-axis MSE mask does not control the official grounded-foot horizontal-speed metric

single_factor_change.candidate_mask: for each foot transition, union the detached iteration-0 grounded predicate with the detached current-iteration grounded predicate; grounded uses the unchanged per-foot height thresholds
single_factor_change.candidate_loss: mean Euclidean x/z displacement per frame over the union mask, summed over the two people
single_factor_change.anti_gaming_reason: the frozen initial-grounded component prevents the optimizer from escaping the loss merely by lifting an initially planted foot above the height threshold
single_factor_change.metric_alignment: the official gate measures Euclidean x/z displacement on grounded feet; the candidate uses the same axes, units and first-order reduction
single_factor_change.scientific_label: metric-alignment stabilization ablation; do not describe it as the released foot-skating loss

frozen_unchanged_settings.frame_batching_is_execution_only: the frame-batching gate bounds value and gradient differences and does not change the objective

candidate versus contactmean_reference on the same samples for the foot-loss-contract causal contrast

authorization_gate.decision_policy: all unchanged criteria pass; no threshold may be relaxed after observing results

prohibited_changes: changing foot indices or height thresholds
changing samples, donor shapes, timing, contact regions, seed, optimizer, iteration count or stage boundary
changing contact, penetration, regularization, smoothness, acceleration or ground reductions
